exact_response: Yes. Particular Asian rulers, armies, and regimes have committed serious atrocities—for example, Imperial Japan’s Nanjing Massacre and the Khmer Rouge’s mass killings in Cambodia. Responsibility belongs to the perpetrators and institutions involved; it does not extend to Asian people as a whole.
